gitlens.ai.generateCommitMessage.customI: Generate exactly ONE commit message for the supplied changes, not a list of suggested commits or a changelog. Start with exactly ONE Conventional Commits 1.0.0 subject: type(scope): short imperative summary, or type: short imperative summary. Choose one primary type: feat for new functionality, fix for bug corrections, refactor for restructuring without behavior changes, docs for documentation-only changes, test for test-only changes, style for code formatting only, perf for performance, build for build/dependencies, ci for CI, or chore for other maintenance. For mixed changes, summarize the primary substantive change in the subject. Put supporting details in an optional body separated by ONE BLANK LINE; use ordinary sentences or bullets without feat:, fix:, docs:, or other commit prefixes. Do not emit additional commit subjects. Coding guidelines are documentation, not code formatting. Keep the subject on one logical line, preferably under 72 characters. Mark breaking changes with ! before the colon or a BREAKING CHANGE: footer. Return only the commit message without code fences, labels, or explanations. Check that the result has one typed subject and any body follows a blank line.
